summary: Add a disposable two-node BIOS/KVM harness for BUG-0093 through BUG-0096 local acceptance. API impact: none; the harness boots private Debian overlays, creates only ignored lab assets, and prepares native NFS, SMB and iSCSI fixtures without changing product behavior.

guide.reason: This is contributor-only disposable-lab setup and changes no operator workflow.

api.reason: The harness uses guest-native services and private SSH only; it introduces no Nex Controller/Core or client-facing contract.

roadmap.reason: Lab preparation neither completes nor changes published product scope.

state.reason: All overlays, generated SSH material, SMB credential, ports and fixture state are disposable ignored .cache assets; the harness creates no product durable state.

verification.method: Ran python3 -m py_compile tests/integration/bug_ledger_lab.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. The first live run used an earlier helper revision with a private-link address and fixture setup corrected during that run; its final observed state was two BIOS/KVM guests, active libvirtd and libvirt-qemu on node b, NFS4 and CIFS mounts writable as libvirt-qemu, and iSCSI discovery of the single-ACL 8 GiB ext4 LUN. The corrected reusable script was inspected after those corrections (systemd-managed ens4 link, root-only credential staging, numeric QEMU ownership, no world-writable source, and no generated iSCSI ACLs), but a full fresh run of that exact revision has not yet been executed. This record makes no BUG-0093--0096 acceptance claim.
